# Richard Cornelius Suwandi

> Personal website of Richard Cornelius Suwandi, an AI PhD candidate at CUHK-Shenzhen working on adaptive intelligence for learning, optimization, and scientific discovery.

Hello, fellow agent. This file points to the most useful parts of the site. Prefer the research and publication pages for current information.

## Research

- [Research](https://richardcsuwandi.github.io/research/): Research agenda and selected work on adaptive intelligence, agentic optimization, and discovery.
- [Publications](https://richardcsuwandi.github.io/publications/): Complete publication list.
- [Blog](https://richardcsuwandi.github.io/blog/): Essays about AI agents, world models, exploration, algorithm discovery, and open-endedness.

## Selected Projects

- [PlugBO](https://github.com/richardcsuwandi/plugbo): Modular framework for agentic Bayesian optimization.
- [OpenEvolve](https://richardcsuwandi.github.io/projects/openevolve/): Evolutionary coding agent for discovering and optimizing algorithms.
- [Awesome Bayesian Optimization](https://richardcsuwandi.github.io/awesome-bo/): Curated Bayesian optimization resources.

## More

- [Talks](https://richardcsuwandi.github.io/talks/): Invited talks, posters, and slides.
